title: DiseasePestTreatmentDatabaseSchema
description: JSON schema for CIB&RC registered pesticide treatments and official non-chemical IPM records.

condition.description: Canonical disease, pest, or physiological condition.

condition_type.description: Classification category: disease, pest, healthy tissue, or unknown.

target.description: Biological target organism or pathology (e.g., 'Alternaria solani', 'Venturia inaequalis', 'Helicoverpa armigera').

active_ingredient.description: Generic active chemical substance or biological strain name. Null for cultural/mechanical methods.

formulation.description: CIB&RC approved formulation abbreviation (e.g., '75% WP', '25% EC', '55% + 5% WG', '18.5% SC'). Null for cultural methods.

registered_use.description: Verbatim or structured summary of registered label claim from CIB&RC or IPM package.

approved_crop.description: Crop explicitly authorized in the statutory registration register.

approved_target.description: Target pest/disease explicitly authorized in the statutory registration register.

application_method.description: Method of application (e.g., 'Foliar Spray', 'Seed Treatment', 'Soil Drench', 'Trap Placement').

dose.description: Exact numerical dose if published in authoritative register. Null if unavailable. Never invented.

dose_unit.description: Unit of measurement (e.g., 'kg/ha', 'ml/ha', 'g/100 L water', 'traps/ha'). Null if dose is null.

pre_harvest_interval.description: Waiting period in days between final application and harvest (PHI). Null if not published.

number_of_applications.description: Maximum number of sprays permitted per cropping cycle. Null if not published.

interval.description: Minimum spray re-application interval in days (e.g., '10-14 days'). Null if not published.

region_scope.description: Geographic jurisdiction of registration. Default 'India' for national statutory CIBRC registration.

source_id.description: Foreign key referencing source_id in sources.json (e.g., 'SRC-CIBRC-2024').

verification_date.description: Date record was verified by agronomic AI team.

verification_status.description: Level of statutory or experimental verification.

notes.description: FRAC / IRAC mode-of-action group and resistance management instructions.

safety_notes.description: Toxicity classification (colour triangle), PPE requirements, environmental, and pollinator warnings.
